recentItems.title: ESCAPE ROOM 🚨 KPop Demon Hunters: Ultimate Fan Show 2 | Netflix Family
recentItems.description:
This is an ad for Mattel. The Ultimate Fan lounge becomes an ESCAPE ROOM when Gwi-Ma entraps the HUNTR/X Fashion Dolls! The gang must solve a series of toy-related and movie-inspired clues and puzzles in order to set them free.

Kicking it off with a clue from Derpy, the Ultimate Fans are set into action, exploring the lounge in ways they never have before. From secret codes to secret compartments, they work together to uncover clues as they reason their way to restoring the honmoon and unlocking the case.

Welcome to KPop Demon Hunters Ultimate Fan Show, the series inspired by the HUNTR/X mantra, "FOR THE FANS!" A gang of KPop Demon Hunters superfans gather in the ultimate clubhouse to play, create, and dish about all things KPop Demon Hunters toys and collectibles.

recentItems.title: Rumi Meets Jinu 😻 KPop Demon Hunters: KPop Toy Creations 1 | Netflix Family
recentItems.description:
In this SCENE RECREATION episode, KPop Toy Creations reimagines the iconic alleyway meet-cute and explores the origins of the Rumi-Jinu relationship.

Casting action figures as action stars, our episode begins when fates align and the Saja Boys BARGE into Rumi's life. Fans will recognize favorite moments from the film, from slow-motion swooning and popcorn eyes to a humiliating showdown on the game show stage.

The HUNTR/X vs Saja Boys rivalry gets even more heated when a battle breaks with rubber ducky demons!?

Welcome to KPop Toy Creations, the series of hand-made cinematic masterpieces inspired by KPop Demon Hunters and produced by one young filmmaking visionary, all between homework and dinner time.

recentItems.title: Fruit x SWORDS! 🍉 KPop Demon Hunters: Play Games with Us 2 | Netflix Family
recentItems.description:
Things get juicy when three contestants compete to slice fruit into perfect halves using only HUNTR/X swords!

Each must take a single swipe and weigh both sides in this juicy challenge of precision and pizzazz. Will it be Rumi's Four Tiger Sword with an apple? Mira's Curved Moon Sword with a watermelon? Or Zoey's Spirit Blades with a grape?

Welcome to Play Games with Us, the series that's full of colorful competitions, challenges and fun, inspired by the iconic scene in KPop Demon Hunters.
